notes:
I couldn't write these notes. My tools stopped working before I got any of the source pages, so I have nothing from the sites you allowed to report.

I tried to load six sources in one go: the Enduring Word commentary on Psalm 73, the Precept Austin page, Ellicott and Gill on Bible Hub, the NET Bible notes, and the Treasury of Scripture Knowledge on StudyLight. A coding mistake meant I couldn't read the results, and then I hit the limit on how many times I could run that tool this turn. My other tools can't reach the internet.

Your rules say to report only what the pages say and to give a URL for every point. Notes written from memory would break both, so I've left everything out.

If you ask again in a new message, my access should be back. I'd start with those six pages, then look for where traditions differ, especially on verse 24 ("later receive me in glory") and verses 25–26. After that I'd check Catholic and Orthodox sources (newadvent.org, catholic.com, oca.org) and any prosperity-teaching discussion of verses 3–12, then write the verse-by-verse notes with a URL for every point.
